about: Fictional official_alerts_at(lat, lon) answers (129-05's RPC shape) for 129-06's Warnings page, Glass count and layout fixture (nearby: a marine warning matched within 3 NM of a berth; offzone: a warning outside every listed issuer's coverage, with a column-aligned table). Times are anchored at 2026-10-14T12:00:00Z; the e2e fixture shifts them to now. No real warning: every name with Zz, 架空, fictional, fictif, test or وهمي/בדיוני/φανταστικό in it is invented.

infos.headline: Special Marine Warning issued October 14 at 7:05AM EDT until October 14 at 8:45AM EDT by NWS Zzbaytown MD
infos.description:
The National Weather Service in Zzbaytown has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
  Fictional Bay from Zz Point to Zz Island...

* Until 845 AM EDT.

* At 704 AM EDT, a fictional thunderstorm was over Fictional Bay, moving east at 25 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar indicated (test text).
infos.instruction: Boaters should seek safe harbor immediately until this storm passes (fictional).
areaDesc: Fictional Bay from Zz Point to Zz Island

infos.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 14 at 2:32AM EDT until October 14 at 6:00PM EDT by NWS Zzbaytown MD
infos.description:
* WHAT...South winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt and waves 3 to 4 ft (fictional).

* WHERE...Fictional Bay from Zz Point to Zz Island and the Zz River.

* WHEN...Until 6 PM EDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft. This sentence is test text, and the next one is too, so that the description runs past the fold: a skipper reads every word of an official warning, and none of it is cut short without a control that says there is more. THE LAST WORDS OF THE FICTIONAL ADVISORY.
infos.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller vessels,
should avoid navigating in these conditions (fictional).
